items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And, Charlie Jones. I got him out of Texas. He was a trumpet player there with me for awhile.

ctx.x: Bill Moore was a beautiful trumpet player. He joined me during the war days. He was a beautiful trumpet player then.
And, Charlie Jones. I got him out of Texas. He was a trumpet player there with me for awhile.

For one while, I had 5 trumpets including Cat Anderson. Cat Anderson was with the Sunset Royal band. So, man, you can imagine 5 trumpets there with Cat Anderson, and then I'm down front, it was 6. And, we were all blowing and Cat was blowing above, and I'm trying to go higher than he. You know. Now, you can imagine the styles we had there. We had those walls rocking. And so, we had a lot of fun.
